channel.title: Human Agency Protocol — specification
channel.description: The open protocol for bounded AI-agent authority: humans authorize, agents execute, and every consequential action requires a signed receipt before it runs.

item.title: Human Agency Protocol — Governance
item.description: How HAP is governed: invariant constraints instead of institutions. No central authority, no registry, no approval process — conformance is enforced locally.

item.title: Human Agency Protocol — Review and Future Directions
item.description: The forward ledger for v0.6: open directions with their targets, deviation notes, implementation status against the spec, and tracked audits. The record of what changed in v0.6 is changelog.md.

item.title: Human Agency Protocol — Core Specification
item.description: The normative HAP specification: profiles, bounds, gates, attestations, content binding, read authorization, owner mandate signatures, and the signed receipt an agent must obtain before a consequential action runs.

item.title: Human Agency Protocol — v0.6 Changelog
item.description: What changed from v0.5 to v0.6, under which promotion rule, with the review record behind each promotion. Forward-looking material lives in review.md.
